FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 70
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/01/2024

Coalition Against Domestic Violence for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2025.
